fieldNotes.temperature: Session maximum temperature in degrees Celsius.
fieldNotes.voltage: Session mean pack voltage in volts.
fieldNotes.voltageDeviation: Session maximum cell-voltage gap in volts.
fieldNotes.current: Absolute value of session mean charging current in amperes. Source charging current is negative.
fieldNotes.alertScore: Not supplied by the AI dataset. Derive in the frontend only if needed.
fieldNotes.alertState: Not supplied by the AI dataset. Derive from documented edge-warning thresholds only.
